scope: Bounded 380-second single-current-GUI Test42 playback passes; interaction/endurance/lower blocks remain unqualified
platform: Steam Deck Galileo, KDE Wayland, Bitwig 6.1 Flatpak
measurement: Existing speaker monitor, float32 stereo, 200ms recorder buffer
comparison: Only the stopped DAW device callback changed from OTHER/nice8 to RR5; process-call/AP10 diagnostics remained off. The grant retired with the owned DAW process. No dependable workaround is established.

missed_graph_boundary.interpretation: One device callback was runnable beyond the block deadline before processing; another missed graph cycle retained an on-time wake and short completed SDK call. Selected task switches do not prove complete competing CPU occupancy. PCM onset has an unclosed 106.951ms offset; no exact sample-to-cycle attribution.

owned_current_gui_pause_comparison.interpretation: Matched observers without perf; supports GUI contribution, not isolated readiness-probe causation. A preexisting older GUI remained active in both arms.

test42_initial_two_gui_fixture.interpretation: The new GUI's passive reads launched no platform helpers; the unchanged older GUI still launched full overview probes. The candidate was insufficient in this fixture and was reverted.

single_current_gui_test41_control.interpretation: Older GUI identity-bound and paused; only one current untraced manager active during music. Same private project, settings, runtime and observers.

single_current_gui_test42_candidate.interpretation: Same older GUI paused in both arms, same policies/affinity and observers. Initial full assessment remains; passive refresh does not repeat platform probes. Bounded playback improvement, not full endurance qualification.

graph_method: Exclude initial R rows with QUANT0/RATE0. New comparisons use timestamped PipeWire follower signal within recorder acquisition start/completion; pw-top encloses startup/teardown and is not the strict endpoint.
timing_method: Entry through body/guard cleanup; fixed observer work included, publication/epilogue excluded. Call duration is not the device deadline.
